trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: frequent small redemption transactions forcing ETWAP updates (e.g., every 5 minutes).

direct_effect.reason: Each update unlocks more redemption capacity, enabling 71% exit rate vs intended cap and more tokens redeemed across multiple tx than in one.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected ~50%/hour cap from documentation vs actual 71% achieved, giving numeric expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the redemption cap/ETWAP logic, the frequent-small-transaction trigger, the resulting capacity unlock and higher exit rate, and a documented numeric cap that is exceeded, sufficient to attempt formalization.
